author: BNK Invest
title: Monday's ETF with Unusual Volume: RDVY - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo The First Trust Rising Dividend Achievers ETF ( RDVY ) is seeing unusually high volume in afternoon trading Monday, with over 356,000 shares traded versus three month average volume of about 141,000. Shares of RDVY were up about 0.3% on the day.
Components of that ETF with the highest volume on Monday were Bank of America ( BAC ), trading up about 0.2% with over 24.1 million shares changing hands so far this session, and Apple ( AAPL ), up about 0.4% on volume of over 15.3 million shares. Intelsat ( I ) is the component faring the best Monday, up by about 3.5% on the day, while Assurant ( AIZ ) is lagging other components of the First Trust Rising Dividend Achievers ETF, trading lower by about 2%.
